name: Microsoft Copilot
desc: Consumer AI assistant across Windows, web, mobile and Edge
desc_zh: 覆盖 Windows、网页、移动端与 Edge 的消费级 AI 助手
solves: You need an answer about your mail and calendar, not a guess. It reads your Microsoft account and answers with that context.
solves_zh: 你要的是关于邮件和日程的确定答案，不是猜测。它读取你的 Microsoft 账号，基于这些上下文作答。
best_for: When the question is about your Outlook mail, your calendar, or your PC settings.
best_for_zh: 当问题涉及 Outlook 邮件、日历或电脑设置时。

revisions.why: 本站 /products/copilot/ 是 GitHub Copilot 手册，不是 Microsoft Copilot；无对应手册，不应显示手册链接
